variables.name: FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (50 MB default). Increase for larger files.

variables.name: GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET
variables.description: S3 bucket name for storage. Auto-created on first startup if missing.

variables.name: AWS_REGION
variables.description: AWS region for S3. MinIO ignores this but the storage API requires a non-empty value.

variables.name: ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION
variables.description: Enable image transformation (resize, optimize). Set to false to save RAM.
